articles.headline: World Cup Daily LIVE: Cristiano Ronaldo's new golden boots, Argentina rest Messi as final groups decided
articles.description: It's the final day of World Cup action from the group stages, as Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo and Argentina's Lionel Messi (maybe) could play on the same day.

articles.headline: World Cup: Grades for every eliminated team as they exit the tournament
articles.description: When the World Cup ends, 47 teams will have been eliminated, and we're grading every one on how their run compared with expectations.

articles.headline: World Cup 2026 - updates as Cape Verde set up Argentina clash, Ghana face Croatia
articles.description: Cape Verde made history on Friday by setting up a round of 32 date with Argentina. Saturday will see Ghana, Congo DR and Algeria in action.

articles.headline: Ghana have nothing to lose vs. Croatia, but higher honours beckon
articles.description: Ghana go into their final group game against Croatia on Saturday knowing that results elsewhere have already secured them their place in the World Cup knockout stages for the first time since 2010.

articles.headline: SAFA confirms death of Bafana midfielder Jayden Adams' grandmother
articles.description: SAFA confirmed Mamelodi Sundowns and Bafana midfielder Jayden Adams played through grief at the FIFA World Cup a day after his grandmother's death.

articles.headline: Not laughing now: How World Cup fans vindicated McKennie's love of ranch
